main_text.p: chamæmeli potu mire iuuant. Quæ si vincan-tur, & vires dolor prosternit stupefacienti-bus sumptis, vt opiatis zazanea Mesuæ ad drachmas duas, vel athanasia Nicolai à dra-chma vna, ad sesquidrach. vel Philonio Ro-mano, Auic. valentissimo à semidrach. ad drachmam vnam. Illa enim somnum cocili-ant, per quem vires instaurantur, nec dolor sentitur. Virtute autem forti adhuc dentur, imbecilla, ne dentur: quia reliquum calorem extinguerent.

3. MATERIAM parantibus, calidam quidem refrigerantibus, & si affluit in ven-triculum bilis, etiam astringentibus: vt, sy-rup. ex succo oxalidis, acetato, rosato, grana-torum, cichorij, intybi, violato cum aquis oxalidis, rosarum plantaginis, solani, cicho-rij, intybi. Frigidam vero et pituitosam (qua-lis plurima esse consueuit) melle rosato, oxy-mel. simpl. vel (si valentiore opus est) com-posito & scillite cum aqua bethonicæ, sal-uiæ, maiorana: syrup. autem & aqua absin-thij pontici, pituitam affigit tenacius ventri-culo

page.notes: Catchword "culo" printed at lower right, treated as the last line of text. Long s rendered as s; the page has no marginal notes. Some words in the scan are faint (e.g., "oxalidis", "intybi") and were read with care.
